title: history/regions: the regions of the mediterraneo_antico base, composed from Natural Earth units (W2-D08)
description: The recipe of each ancient region (what modern units make its shape), apart from history/places (the points, with Pleiades) because the two have different sources and different rows. Version 2 adds the optional `since` year with its source (negative = a.C., no year 0, as lesson/chrono); there is no ad hoc key for dates. ids resolve per base: this table is read by the areas of mediterraneo_antico only.

since.description: The year from which the region is what the name says (a province from its year of creation); negative = a.C.
